name: jsonscan
algorithm: A JSON tokenizer over a 32 MB generated document, hashing every token, repeated rounds times (README.md).

skip.mk-wrap: the hash already uses the wrapping operators in every column (overflow class wraps)

no_counts: B24: every token goes into the order-sensitive hash with its class (a string by its decoded length, a number by its digits and sign, a literal or punctuation byte by its code), so a scanner that splits or classifies one token differently changes the checksum
